correctness.rationale: For odd n, closing phase errors around the frustrated loop sum to pi mod 2pi. Each positive-weight cosine error can be reduced monotonically until total unsigned error equals pi, leaving a single-sign simplex. Strict cosine pair averaging forces n-1 equal strong errors; the maximization reduces to B_w(delta)=k cos(delta)-w cos(k delta). Strict decrease of sin(k delta)/sin(delta) on (0,pi/k) proves exact uniqueness, transition, and two chiral optimizers. Taylor series yields square-root current and quadratic energy gap; constrained Hessian proves hyperbolicity away from threshold. Independently optimized 1080 randomized trials for 36 finite cases, including threshold, agreed within tolerance; not an infinite proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Unweighted Huygens rings prove convergence to uniform twists and classify their minima, but w=1 is one point and supplies no w-dependent 1/(n-1) transition. General graph gradient-potential facts do not furnish exact defective ring minimizer counts or sharp coefficients. A full published three-oscillator special-case paper does not logically cover n>=5.

originality.rationale: The main October 2026 full text defines an unweighted cycle, classifies equal-edge uniform twisted sinks, and contains no defective-edge parameter or sharp defect strength. Its unweighted result w=1 cannot imply the full w-dependent chirality transition including the small-w phase. A published detailed 3-node weighted triangle result and distinct 4-node Braess example were compared by scope/parameter and do not cover all odd n>=5. Actual published-finding corpus searches and prior 52 accessible claims do not show broader coverage; classical older defective XY literature remains a declared priority risk.
residual_risks: Some earlier classical frustrated XY/Josephson weak-link derivations may already imply the same scalar threshold despite different terminology; priority is provisional.
Full original texts of some plausible classic and October 2026 network sources were not accessible.
Numerical optimizer checks of finite n do not certify correctness at all n; analytic reduction does.

value.rationale: A single defective link is the most economical physically meaningful nonuniform perturbation of the odd frustrated phase ring. Classifying its entire ground-state set for every odd length and all positive strengths identifies the exact localized-to-chiral transition, its universal size-dependent sharp threshold, emergent current and energy singularity, including a nonhyperbolic critical state. These are complete natural phase-diagram facts, not numerical recomputation or routine substitution; they quantify whether the frustration remains confined to a defect or spreads around the ring.
